title: Gaucher, Fabry, amyloidosis, adrenal and pituitary disorders
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's metabolic or endocrine disorder (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for weight gain and moon face.

HPI
70 y/o female pt presents for f/u of Cushing's syndrome. Pt has been on long-term prednisone for chronic lung condition. Pt reports gradual weight gain and truncal obesity over the last 6 months. Denies acute respiratory distress or fever. Pt aware of the link between long-term glucocorticoid use and current symptoms.

Medication List
Prednisone 20mg daily
Albuterol inhaler PRN
Salbutamol (maintenance)

Exam
General: Alert, oriented x3. Appearance: notable for moon face and truncal obesity.
Vitals: BP 138/88, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F.
Lungs: CTAB.
Heart: RRR.
Skin: Thin skin, wide face.
Extremities: No edema.

Assessment
1. Cushing's syndrome secondary to long-term prednisone use for pulmonary disease.

Plan
1. Initiate slow taper of prednisone to minimize risk of flares. 
2. Monitor weight and blood pressure weekly.
3. F/u in 4 weeks to reassess.

Electronically signed,
R. Mensah, DO
10/14/2026

distractors.why: It is caused by steroid medication, not the pituitary.
